label: Week 8
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
volume_note: Week volume is the sum of nightly volumes; all 7 nights have counts for all 32 clubs. HOU and JAX kept only two filter-passed club stories for the week, so they show two topics instead of three.
headline: Week 8 was trade-deadline week, and Seattle ran loudest after a 20-3 rout of Kansas City and the Quenton Nelson deal out of Indianapolis, with Chicago right behind on the Jeffery Simmons blockbuster, Khalil Mack reunion talks and an Arlington Heights stadium deal. Green Bay (a flag fight in a 20-17 loss at Detroit, then a 27-19 Thursday win over Carolina) and Dallas (a 38-21 Monday rout of Philadelphia plus Maxx Crosby and Patrick Queen calls) were next, while Philadelphia absorbed Jalen Hurts' season-ending clots and unbeaten Minnesota fielded Kyler Murray debate and Jonathan Taylor rumors. Cleveland and Pittsburgh built toward Sunday's AFC North showdown, Carolina fired DC Ejiro Evero after two losses, and Detroit rounded out the loud rooms with Riq Woolen trade talks after the Packers win. All seven nights logged with counts for all 32 clubs; Washington, the Chargers and Jacksonville were quietest. Vibe only.
